author: Marcus R. Brown
description:
Closes three high-severity advisories that each had their own bot-authored PR.

## Why one PR instead of three rebases

`#1838`, `#1866`, and `#1862` all edit the same `overrides` block in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`. Once the nanoid override landed in `#1904`, the remaining three conflicted against `main` and against each other — same two files, same conflict class every time. Rebasing them sequentially means three rounds of the same merge resolution. One entry point is cheaper and easier to review.

## Overrides added

| Package | Floor | Advisory | Resolves to | Replaces |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `adm-zip` | `^0.6.0` | GHSA-xcpc-8h2w-3j85 | 0.6.0 | #1838 |
| `brace-expansion` | `^5.0.8` | GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg | 5.0.9 | #1866 |
| `postcss` | `^8.5.23` | GHSA-r28c-9q8g-f849 | 8.5.26 | #1862 |

## Note on the postcss floor

`#1862`'s title says `^8.5.12`, but its actual diff already targeted `^8.5.18` — the title was stale. `^8.5.18` clears the high advisory (GHSA-r28c-9q8g-f849) but leaves medium GHSA-fxqj-rqcc-2cmp open. This raises the floor to `^8.5.23` so both are closed by constraint rather than by whatever resolution happens to land.

## Verification

- `pnpm install` resolves cleanly; lockfile shrinks 819723 → 818697 bytes
- Resolved versions confirmed against the lockfile: `adm-zip 0.6.0`, `brace-expansion 5.0.9`, `postcss 8.5.26`, `nanoid 3.3.18`
- `pnpm check` — exit 0
- `pnpm build` — 10/10 tasks, docs site builds 71 pages

## Follow-up

Supersedes #1838, #1866, #1862 — those should close once this merges.

Advisories the autohealing report flagged as unremediable are unaffected and remain open: `fast-uri` (transitive via `ajv`, dev-only), `extract-zip` (no patched version upstream), `image-size` (no patched version, Expo/Metro toolchain).
title: fix(deps): consolidate outstanding security overrides
